evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## The NKL Aerospace Engineering Scholarship

**$1,000 value**

The applicant must be enrolled or accepted in an accredited two- or fouryear college, technical institution, or certificate program with a declared
major in aerospace engineering and a minimum 3.0 GPA (on a 4.0 scale).
Applicant must provide a copy of an enrollment acceptance letter, be a
U.S. citizen or eligible noncitizen, and a volunteer in STEM and aviationrelated events and/or WAI activities. Submit a 500- to 1,000-word essay,

typed and double spaced, addressing the following topics: financial need,
who or what inspired you to pursue a degree/career in aerospace engineering, what career path are you pursuing, and how are you involved in
aviation and community service. Scholarship funds will be paid directly
to the recipient’s educational institution.

evidence.excerpt:
## The White Family Legacy Scholarship

## TWO OFFERED – each at $3,000 value

The White Family Legacy Scholarship offers two $3000 scholarships to individuals working on a fixed-wing aircraft instrument or multi-engine rating, or commercial or CFI certificate. Funds will be paid directly to your
flight school. Flight training must be completed within one year of receipt
of the scholarship.

Minimum requirements: private pilot certificate, 100 hours of flight
time, and a current copy of the written test results for the certificate/rating
sought. One letter of recommendation from a pilot who has flown with you.
The recipient will be chosen based on merit, career aspirations and dedication, and contributions to the community. In your essay, please address how
the funds will be used, and your professional goals. Also, please discuss any
community or volunteer service organizations you are a member of, including dates and hours of service and a summary of your activities.

must expect to receive their commercial helicopter pilot rating after January 1, 2027 (if you receive your rating before this date, you are not eligible

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

## Vertical Aviation / WAI Commercial Helicopter Pilot Rating Scholarships

## Rating Scholarships for

**$2,500 value**

This scholarship provides $2,500 to applicants who want to attain their
commercial helicopter ratings. Applicants must already have their private
pilot license and be enrolled in a commercial helicopter rating program at
an FAA-approved Part 141 school or international equivalent. Applicants
must expect to receive their commercial helicopter pilot rating after January 1, 2027 (if you receive your rating before this date, you are not eligible
to apply).

• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific
award/grant scholarship

• official WAI application form

• WAI online application portal submission

evidence.excerpt:
## Women Military Aviators Dream of Flight Scholarship

## TWO OFFERED – at $3,000 each                 U.S. SCHOOLS ONLY

Women Military Aviators (WMA) seeks to preserve, for history, the
important role women have played in creating and supporting the American Spirit through their contributions to flight, aeronautics, and space.
These elite bands of women have not only a love of aviation but have put
their lives on the line in defense of their country through their military
service. WMA is committed to passing this legacy from one generation of
women to another and has established an annual scholarship program in
support of this commitment. Advocating the love of aviation, WMA offers an annual scholarship to advance a woman in her pursuit of flight ratings at an accredited institution or FAA Approved Part 141 or Part 61 flight
school. Over the past 30 years this scholarship has been given to select
candidates so that they may pursue opportunities in aviation.

Applicants must write about their demonstrated persistence and determination to flight.

State ability to complete training at an accredited institution or FAA
Part 141 or Part 61 flight school within one year of scholarship award.
Identify the school, college, university, Part 141 or Part 61 flight school
where training will be completed. Specifically address the program and/or
ratings being sought. Address your interest and/or participation in military
aviation. Address your financial need.

evidence.excerpt:
• Be a WAI member by August 30, 2026, and with a membership expiration of March 30, 2027, or later.

• Apply for up to three scholarships.

• Scholarships are awarded at the 38th Annual Women in
Aviation International Conference in Savannah, Georgia, at
the Savannah Convention Center on Friday, February 26, 2027.

• Submit applications online by the September 1, 2026, 11:59
p.m. EST deadline.

• Most recipients of the WAI2027 scholarships will be notified
by December 15, 2026.

The requirements listed below are the minimum for all
scholarships unless otherwise indicated. Some scholarships
may require additional information. Please read each description thoroughly to make sure you meet all requirements.

**ALL APPLICATIONS SHOULD INCLUDE:**

• two (one-page) recommendation letters

• typed, descriptive 500-word essay

• professional resume

• copies of all aviation and medical certificates and the last three pages of your pilot logbook (if applying for flight training scholarships)

• other applicable information as requested for each specific

# PAPA selected public program/FAQ evidence

### **SCHOLARSHIPS & GRANTS**

Pursuing a career in aviation can be a long and costly pursuit. At PAPA, we strive to do our part in helping ensure that no qualified individual who aspires to become an aviation professional has to give up on their dream, solely because of financial reasons.

Since 2021, we have awarded over **$3 million** in scholarships to PAPA members. We usually open up our scholarship window twice a year. Once in the spring and once in the fall. **Anyone** can apply as long as they are a PAPA member and meet the criteria outlined by the sponsoring partner. Most scholarships will be paid directly towards the recipient’s institution.

We are proud to provide annual scholarships in conjunction with our partner organizations. Here’s to breaking down barriers in aviation!

**The 2026 Fall Scholarship window is now closed!**

**Please look forward to our next scholarship window in March of 2027**.

### **Frequently Asked Questions**

- #### When will I be able to see which scholarships are available?






The website will be updated for each Spring and Fall Scholarship window so check back around those times.

- #### Can non-PAPA members receive a scholarship?






No. You must be a member of PAPA to receive a scholarship award. To become a member, visit our [**Members Area**](https://www.asianpilots.org/member-scholarships).

- #### What are the scholarship requirements?






General requirements include being at least 18 years of age, high school diploma or GED equivalent, Each scholarship has its own independent requirements. Log in with your PAPA membership credentials to view each individual scholarship.

- #### I am not Asian, can I still apply for and receive a scholarship?






Yes! Everyone is eligible regardless of race and ethnicity. Some scholarships may be decided based on past or current involvement in the Asian community.

- #### How much is each scholarship worth?






Scholarships range anywhere from $2,500 to $7,500 generally. These are subject to change yearly depending on sponsorship.

- #### How long after the application deadline will we be notified if we are awarded a scholarship?






The application process takes our scholarship team about 2-3 weeks after the window closes to review and finalize our scholarship recipients.

- #### When do the scholarships open? How often are there scholarship opportunities?






The scholarship windows open in the Spring and Fall, providing two scholarship application opportunities.

- #### Can I apply for more than one scholarship?






Yes, you may apply to any scholarship that you are eligible for.

- #### Can I apply as an international student?






Yes. You must be able to work in the United States and be a green card holder.

- #### Can I apply for the United Aviate Academy scholarship as a current student?






Yes, you may apply as long as you have a conditional acceptance letter from the United Aviate Academy and be an active student at the application close date.

- #### How are scholarship funds disbursed?






Funds will be disbursed directly to your flight school/university via check.

- #### How soon do I need to begin utilizing my scholarship award and how quickly does it need to be used?






Your funds can be used as soon as it is awarded. It is to be used within one year of awarding.

- #### Can I be awarded a scholarship as a past recipient?






Yes, you can be awarded a scholarship as a past recipient.

# 11th Annual Epic Aviation Scholarship Awards in 2026

Updated October 12th, 2026

### MECHANICS:

- 2 – **$20,000 Aircraft Mechanic Scholarships** for Aircraft Mechanics (One each at [CVG Airport](https://epicflightacademy.com/locations-erlanger/) and [New Smyrna Beach](https://epicflightacademy.com/aircraft-mechanic/))
- 2- **$10,000 Aircraft Mechanic Scholarships** for Aircraft Mechanics (One each at CVG Airport and New Smyrna Beach)

Epic’s aviation scholarship program continues to grow each year to support young people interested in aviation. **These scholarships are open to U.S. high school students only.**

## High School Scholarship Requirements

- First, the **applicant must be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident**.
- Furthermore, the applicant must currently be a junior or senior attending high school in the U.S. for the flight training scholarships.
- For the aircraft mechanic scholarship, applicants must currently be a senior attending high school in the U.S.
- Applicants must be turning 16 years of age or older on or before December 31, 2026 (flight training); or, you must be 18 years old by time of completing program (aircraft mechanic)
- All applicants must be able to start training within 12 months of receiving the scholarship.
- Also, you must be able to use the scholarship within 24 months.
- Additionally, you must have parent or guardian’s approval if under 18 years of age.
- Most importantly, applicants must have consistent, reliable transportation to attend Epic Flight Academy or be willing to relocate to your respective campus during training.
- Finally, you must be able to present a [Third Class Medical](https://epicflightacademy.com/flight-school-faq/what-exams-are-required-to-get-my-private-pilot-rating-and-where-do-i-take-them/) for the flight training scholarship.

## High School Scholarship Application Details

### DEADLINE TO SUBMIT APPLICATION WAS OCTOBER 1, 2026

Our goal is to give applicants the opportunity to provide quality submissions and showcase their attitudes. We are interested in learning your views on aviation, your achievements, and other qualities.

Applicants should first **review the requirements of the Scholarship Application** below. Then, applicants should complete all steps, such as securing letters of recommendation. Lastly, they should upload all required documents.

### What is included in your application?

- **Upload PDF document containing Community Service Involvement & Extracurricular Activities**, including Organization/Affiliation, Date and Duration, and Location (for pilots only)

- **Upload PDF document containing responses to both of the following Short Essay prompts**:
  - Short Essay 1: What personal attributes would you look for in a scholarship applicant? (for pilots only)
  - Short Essay 2: What is your motivation for your aviation training? (Include your goals.)
- **Upload 2 Letters of Recommendation:** At least one must be from a high school teacher, counselor, coach, or other school official. Both Letters of Recommendation may be from teachers, counselors, coaches, or other school officials. Letters of Recommendation must not be from anyone related to you, including a guardian. Letters of Recommendation should be from adults who have served in a supervisory role to you. Please ensure that the Letters of Recommendation include the reference’s contact information.

- **Create YouTube Video:** In two minutes or less, explain why you feel that you are the strongest candidate to receive a scholarship. Upload the video to YouTube, and be prepared to provide the link in the application.

- **Upload Aviation-Related Photo:** Provide us with an aviation-related photo of yourself in either jpg, jpeg, or png file format. If you win, we will share your photo on our website and in other scholarship materials.

## How to Apply

Scholarship applications have closed for 2026.

## Scholarship FAQs

**How many scholarships will be awarded in 2026?** We will award 14 pilot scholarships and 4 aircraft mechanic scholarships to eligible high school students.

**What is included in the high school scholarship application?** The application consists of:

- two short essay questions (pilot app only)
- your current high school information (both pilot and mechanic apps)
- community service (pilot only)
- letters of recommendation (both pilot and mechanic)
- one video uploaded to YouTube (both pilot and mechanic)
- one photo (both pilot and mechanic)

**Do I get additional points for submitting my application earlier that other applicants?** The date an application is received carries no weight in the scoring process. However, the application must be submitted by the **October 1st deadline**.

**When will I know if I’ve been selected for the final round?** We will notify finalists by October 28th.
